verifyDropHint.message: Or run with nothing and this stays put. Private: files never leave your machine.

verifyLoadingHint.message: Watermark detection is CPU-heavy on audio and video and can take a few minutes. Uncheck "Run watermark detection" for an instant C2PA-only verify.

wmDropTitle.message: Drop any file here to run watermark detection

wmDropHint.message: Private: files never leave your machine. Each detector is authoritative about whether it applies to the input file type.

wmLoadingHint.message: Model inference is CPU-heavy on audio and video; a scan can take a few minutes. Still working while this spins.

detectTitle.message: AI-content detection: bring your own detector

detectRouteAHead.message: Route A: paid DLC pack (v1.x, planned)

keysRotateTitle.message: Mint a fresh signing key and publish it as the new active record

keysSwitchYubikeyTitle.message: Replace the current identity with a Yubikey-backed one

keysRecordsEmptyHint.message: Log in on the Sign tab + publish your local fingerprint.

keysNoSessionHint.message: Log in on the Sign tab to fetch your published records.

signSetupBody.message: This generates a cryptographic key on this machine and stores it in your OS keychain. You'll only need to do this once.

signSetupHint.message: The key never leaves your machine. Your OS handles access prompts.

signConnectBody.message: Attach your signing key to your atproto handle so verifiers know it's yours.

signPublishBody.message: One last step: publishing your key's fingerprint to atproto lets verifiers cross-check that you signed your work. Without this they only see "valid signature by unknown."

signStaleTitle.message: Your signing key is out of date

signStaleHint.message: This mints a fresh key, publishes it as the new active record, and (when needed) revokes the orphan record so no one can sign in your name with the lost key.

signDropTitle.message: Drop a file here to sign

signDropSub.message: Audio · Image · Video: anything c2pa-rs supports.

signChainSub.message: Your signature will join the chain as a derivative; the original signature stays intact.

signRelationshipQ.message: What's your relationship to this file?

signEmbedIdentity.message: Embed identity assertion (recommended; lets verifiers skip the handle entry step)

signReplaceOriginal.message: Replace the original (instead of writing a sidecar)

signErrorTitle.message: Could not load your signing status

bfBackfireSub.message: Verify a per-image watermark that AI provenance strippers amplify instead of remove.

bfReadFreeEmbedDlc.message: Reading keyed marks here is free. Creating them (embedding a keyed Backfire, Mellin, or idmark mark with our codecs) is a paid, commercial capability in the DLC, not part of this free app. Commercial licensing: licensing@creativemayhem.com.

bfDropTitle.message: Drop an image here, or choose one, to read its mark

bfHint.message: Enter your key above first, then drop or choose an image. It reads automatically, and stays on your machine.

mlSub.message: Audio-side keyed forensics: recover the 64-bit per-copy serial you embedded with the standalone, BUSL-licensed provcheck-mellin tool (free for non-commercial use, separate from provcheck). Needs your seller secret file and work id; everything stays on your machine.

mlSecretNone.message: none chosen. The secret is never stored, so pick it again after every launch.

mlWorkidPh.message: the work id used at embed

mlDropTitle.message: Choose an audio file to read its serial

mlHint.message: Pick your secret file and enter the work id first, then choose the audio or drop it anywhere on this tab. Any format works (WAV, MP3, AAC, FLAC); audio files read here, images read the Backfire mark above.

imTitle.message: Read a keyed idmark identity mark

imSub.message: Image-side keyed identity: read the crop, transcode, and rotation-tolerant per-copy mark embedded with the standalone, BUSL-licensed provcheck-idmark tool (free for non-commercial use, separate from provcheck). With no secret it checks the built-in mark; add your secret file and a seat to attribute a copy. Everything stays on your machine.

imSecretNone.message: none chosen. Leave empty to read the built-in mark; the secret is never stored.

imDropTitle.message: Choose an image to read its mark

imHint.message: Optionally pick your secret file and a seat first, then choose the image. PNG or JPEG. This reads the idmark identity mark; the Backfire mark and Mellin serials are read in the sections above.

attMatchSub.message: Signing certificate matches a key published under this identity.

attMismatchSub.message: Signing certificate does not match any key published under this identity.

attNotPublishedSub.message: This identity exists but has not published any signingKey records.

wmKeyedNote.message: Keyed marks (Backfire, Mellin) are not part of this scan. They can only be read with your key, on the Keyed marks tab.

wmDegraded.message: $1% confidence; mark is degraded (partial corruption likely)
